info.title: Goodfit Dataset API
info.description: The companies and contacts in your Goodfit dataset, its segments, and CSV exports of it.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Your Goodfit API key, sent as the bare header value

post.description: Saves a segment and starts calculating its companies, which runs in the background: the segment comes back UPDATING, so poll GET /segments/{segmentId} until it is READY. Spends no credits.

filters.description: Filter group over your dataset’s data points, in the same format as company search. List the data points first (dataset_list_company_fields, or GET /companies/fields)

excludeDomains.description: Companies left out whatever the filters say

anyOf.description: Caps the segment at a number of companies, keeping the first by orderBy

max.description: At most this many companies are included

orderBy.description: fieldName of the data point that decides which companies stay

isDynamic.description: A dynamic segment refreshes after every dataset sync

status.description: NEW: companies never calculated. UPDATING: recalculating companies after a criteria change. REFRESHING: recalculating companies and searching for contacts. READY: up to date. FAILED: the last calculation or refresh failed; companies from the last good run stay listed

sizeCompanies.description: Companies in the segment. Null until first calculated

A name or isDynamic change alone saves straight away (200). A dynamic segment with personas searches for contacts after every dataset sync, spending contact credits.

post.description: Recalculates the companies and searches again for contacts for each persona on the segment, in the background (202): poll GET /segments/{segmentId} until it is READY.
